rubric_items.reason: All 11 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-11) are traced by S-1 to S-4. The intent has no assumed REQs.
S-1 to S-3 each have one outcome. S-4 puts two outcomes together: the dashboard is unchanged (REQ-8, REQ-9) and it shows no private data (REQ-10, REQ-11).

The ACs are Given/When/Then and mostly catch likely wrong implementations (most-recent status, by-date counting, a period applied to the count). No AC tests an appointment that starts exactly at now, so < and <= both pass.
Values are test-fixture times and dates. The out-of-window date is explained inline using the glossary Period (C12). No limits are invented.
Readable, with terms used consistently. However, the body text of S-4 AC4 differs from the front matter, and Open questions says None but then refers to an intent question that does not exist.

findings.text: REQ-2 counts only appointments whose start time is before now, but no AC puts a Scheduled appointment at exactly now. The nearest is 10:30 against now at 10:00, so a <= implementation passes every AC.

cites.quote: another Scheduled appointment starts later today at 10:30

findings.suggested_fix: Add an S-1 AC: given it is 10:00 and a Scheduled appointment starts at exactly 10:00, the tile does not count it.

findings.text: Open questions says the contact-details-in-list question is the intent's non-blocking question for the product owner. The intent has no questions and its Open questions section says None, so the artifact attributes a question to the intent that is not there.

cites.quote: is the intent's non-blocking question for the product owner
None. The ticket fixes every value the requirements need

findings.suggested_fix: Either record it as this artifact's own non-blocking question for the product owner, or delete the attribution to the intent.

findings.text: The body text of S-4 AC4 has an extra sentence that the front-matter AC4 does not have, so the two copies of the criterion differ.

cites.quote: Medical history never appears in lists or on the dashboard (C14).

findings.suggested_fix: Move that sentence into the Known rationale, or add it to the front-matter AC4, so both copies match.

findings.text: S-4 combines two separate outcomes: the dashboard is unchanged (REQ-8, REQ-9) and it shows no private data (REQ-10, REQ-11).

cites.quote: The rest of the dashboard is unchanged and shows no private data

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-4 into one story for the unchanged dashboard (REQ-8, REQ-9) and one for no private data (REQ-10, REQ-11).
